title: Combine parts and meaning
instructions: Use the word parts and the sentence together, then choose the best answer.

parts.prompt: The forest path was impassable after the storm, so the group turned back. What does “impassable” most nearly mean?

choice_rationales.A: They knew where the path was.
choice_rationales.B: How it looks is not why they turned back.
choice_rationales.C: Nobody closed it; the storm damaged it.
choice_rationales.D: Im- means not, pass means go through, and -able means can be done.

parts.hint: Split the word into three parts.
parts.correct_explanation: The parts suggest cannot be passed, and the group turned back.
